label: defined by the PYRO-ASTRA team
description: Rule-based keyword dictionary defining the 6 PYRO-ASTRA spacecraft fire safety functional domains.

functions.name: Detection
functions.description: Smoke, aerosol, gas, or particulate detection and sensor response under microgravity conditions.

functions.name: Suppression
functions.description: Physical and chemical fire extinguishment, gaseous suppressants (CO2, He, N2), water mist, and quenching.

functions.name: Material flammability screening
functions.description: Solid material flammability screening protocols, bridging normal-gravity standards (NASA-STD-6001 Test 1) to flight environments.

functions.name: Fire growth and spread
functions.description: Empirical rates of flame spread, propagation directions (concurrent vs opposed), and large-scale fire growth.

functions.name: Ventilation/airflow effects
functions.description: Effects of low-velocity convective airflow, forced duct ventilation, and sub-buoyant flow speeds on combustion.

functions.name: Extinction limits
functions.description: Limiting oxygen index (LOI), radiative and diffusive extinction boundaries, and low-speed flame quench limits.
